verdict.rationale: Skills live as plain `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` markdown files (the raw SKILL.md URLs in docs-15/16/17). The porting guide says everything in `skills/` is shared verbatim by every harness and that porting never edits SKILL.md files. The project also documents installs across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin, Hermes and others, plus the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` alias. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of copying skills between harnesses by hand; full auto-trigger behaviour still needs a per-harness bootstrap injector and tool-mapping, plus a separate install for each harness.
